events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, took place on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock's Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. What was your favourite performance from the legendary festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who died in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music and influence are truly immortal.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Shot in Las Vegas
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas, succumbing to his injuries six days later.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history. Remembering Tupac Shakur, who was shot on this day in 1996, leaving an indelible mark on hip-hop.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost a true guitar icon. Remembering Jimi Hendrix and his revolutionary sound.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: A masterpiece turns 57! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released today in 1969. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: The iPod Era
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? The first iPod was released on this day in 2001. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy film franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eponymous double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' album that pushed boundaries was released today in 1965. A true game-changer.
